we present a novel approach for recognizing first person interactions that outperforms the current state of the art in terms of recognition accuracy, while at the same time it is simple and easy to implement.

by combining a convolutional neural network with a convolutional long-short term memory we can achieve state of the art performance in recognizing interactions from first person perspective.
